units.source_text: 小屋的入口，一半以上被沙子堵住了，看不清里边的情景。

en.t: More than half of the hut's entrance was blocked by sand, so he could not make out what was inside.
Was it the mouth of an old well?

units.source_text: 为了防沙，井口盖一间小屋也并没有什么奇怪。

en.t: There would be nothing strange about building a small hut over a wellhead to keep out the sand.

units.source_text: 不过，这地方不像是有水源……

en.t: Still, this did not look like a place with a water source...

units.source_text: 他想伸头看一看，这回正宗的狗气味扑鼻而来。

en.t: He tried to stick his head in and look, and this time the unmistakable smell of dog rushed into his nose.

units.source_text: 动物的体臭，的确是超越哲学的存在。

en.t: The body odor of an animal was indeed something that transcended philosophy.

units.source_text: 有个社会主义者说过，他喜欢朝鲜人的精神，却受不了那股气味……

en.t: A certain socialist had once said that he admired the spirit of the Koreans, but could not stand that smell...

units.source_text: 话虽如此，但要是时间横向流动的话，快点流起来给我看看呀！

en.t: Even so, if time was supposed to flow sideways, then hurry up and show me it flowing!

units.source_text: ……期待和不安……解放感和焦虑……这种焦躁，最受不了。

en.t: ...Expectation and unease... a sense of release and anxiety... this kind of restlessness was the hardest thing to bear.

units.source_text: 他把手巾摊在脸上，向后仰着倒了下去。

en.t: He spread the towel over his face and fell backward onto his back.

units.source_text: 这玩意儿就是我的气味，就是说奉承话大概也算不上上等吧。

en.t: This thing was my own smell, and even as flattery it could hardly be called first-rate.
